similar_member_bills.bill_title: To amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to provide for additional uses of funds for grants to strengthen historically Black colleges and universities, and for other purposes.

evidence.target_passage: only 2.5 percent of Black Americans are owners of Arts-Entertainment business. Historically Black colleges and universities, or HBCUs, are uniquely positioned to produce a diverse generation of art professionals and help bring much needed attention to works by Black artists.
